name: veterinary_clinic_system_048_appointment_reason_triage
instruction: Triage tagging for upcoming visits. For every appointment on or after the episode date with status 'scheduled' or 'confirmed', add a triage_tier field: 'urgent' if the reason mentions vomiting, limping/lameness, or 'ear infection' (case-insensitive); 'routine' if it mentions wellness, vaccine, or weight management; 'standard' for everything else. Pre-episode and historical-status appointments stay untouched.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute expected tier per appointment from snapshot reasons with the documented keyword rules (vomit|limping|lameness|ear infection -> urgent; wellness|vaccine|weight management -> routine; else standard), date>=ep, status in set. Assert tier on exactly those rows; others byte-identical; count 46.
